segments.he:
א.

מַה שֶּׁהַצַּדִּיק מְקַבֵּל מָמוֹן מֵהָרָשָׁע, אַף־עַל־פִּי שֶׁזֶּה הַמָּמוֹן הוּא סָפֵק גֶּזֶל, אַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן מֻתָּר לְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ, כְּדֵי שֶּׁלֹּא יְקַבֵּל הָרָשָׁע לְעַצְמוֹ אֵיזֶהוּ תַּלְמִיד חָכָם רָשָׁע, וְיֹּאמַר עָלָיו שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק, וְיִתֵּן לוֹ הַמָּמוֹן, וְיַחֲלֹק עַל הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת.
segments.en: bad. Also, they deepen Hell for him. This also applies to one who hears [such speech] and remains silent.

segments.he:
ב.

מִשֶּׁרַבּוּ מְקַבְּלֵי מַתָּנוֹת, נִתְמַעֲטוּ הַיָּמִים וְנִתְקַצְּרוּ הַשָּׁנִים.
segments.en: More stringent is one who speaks verbally than the one who performs an action.

segments.he:
ג.

אָדָם – שֶׁקִּבַּלְתָּ הֲנָאָה מִמֶּנּוּ פַּעַם אֶחָד, אַל תְּבַזֵּהוּ.
segments.en: When a  Tzaddik  accepts money from a wicked person, even if the money is possibly stolen, it is permitted for the  Tzaddik  to accept it, so that the wicked one will not take on some wicked Torah scholar, claiming that the scholar is a  Tzaddik , giving him the money, and he will oppose the True  Tzaddik .

segments.he:
ד.

מִי שֶׁמַּכְבִּיד עֻלּוֹ עַל בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְסוֹף שֶׁנִּצְרָךְ לַאֲחֵרִים.
segments.en: Since the proliferation of those who accept gifts, days have become diminished and years shortened.

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה טוֹבוֹת לִבְנֵי־אָדָם, מֻתָּר לוֹ לֵהָנוֹת מֵהֶם וּצְרִיכִים לְשָׁרְתוֹ.
segments.en: A person who you received benefit from one time - do not humiliate him.

segments.he:
ו.

עַל־יְדֵי הֲנָאָה שֶׁאַתָּה מְקַבֵּל מֵחֲבֶרְךָ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה אַתָּה סוֹבֵל צַעַר עַל עֲווֹנוֹתָיו.
segments.en: One who weighs his clout on the Jewish people ends up being needy of others .

segments.he:
ז.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל מָמוֹן מֵאֲחֵרִים, יְגַדֵּל כָּל זַרְעוֹ.
segments.en: One who does favors for others is permitted to benefit from them, and they ought to serve him.

segments.he:
ח.

הַמֶּלֶךְ גּוֹבֶה יְצִיאוֹתָיו מִן הָעָם.
segments.en: Through the benefit you receive from your fellow man, through this you suffer pain due to his sins.

segments.he:
ט.

צָרִיךְ לַעֲסֹק בְּאֵיזֶה מַשָּׂא־וּמַתָּן, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִצְטָרֵךְ לְסוֹף לְבַטֵּל מִדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה.
segments.en: One who does not accept money from others,  raise all his children.

segments.he:
י.

מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹאֵל חֶלְקוֹ בְּפִיו, כְּאִלּוּ גָּזַל.
segments.en: The King funds his expenditures from the people.

segments.he:
יא.

הַמְצַפֶּה לְשֻׁלְחַן חֲבֵרוֹ, עוֹלָם חָשַׁךְ בַּעֲדוֹ גַּם חַיָּיו אֵינָם חַיִּים.
segments.en: One must be involved in some form of business, in order that ultimately he will not need arrest the study of  (lit. words of)  Torah.

segments.he:
יב.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ נְשָׁמָה, הוּא נֶהֱנֶה מֵרֵיחַ.
segments.en: One who asks for his portion verbally is as if he had stolen.
One who is reliant on his friend's table, his world is darkened, and his life is not considered life.

segments.he:
יד.

גְּדוֹלָה יְגִיעַ כַּפּוֹ, שֶׁמַּצִּיל אֶת הָאָדָם מֵהֲרִיגָה.
segments.en: One who has a  N eshamah (3 rd  level of the Jewish soul) , he ha s  pleasure from scent .

segments.he:
טו.

מִי שֶׁהוּא שׂוֹנֵא מַתָּנוֹת, אֵינוֹ מִתְיָרֵא מֵעֲלִילוֹת.

segments.en: Great is [the benefit from] the work of one's own hands, for it saves a man from killing.
One who hates  (accepting)  gifts does not fear from false accusations.
